title: Ocean Friends Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12
subtitle: Bold & Easy Sea Creatures with Fun Underwater Designs
description: Dive into a colorful underwater adventure! This sea creatures coloring book features 5 adorable ocean animals with bold, thick outlines perfect for kids ages 6-12. From a friendly dolphin to a cheerful octopus, each page brings the ocean to life with fun, easy-to-color designs. Grab your crayons and explore the deep blue sea!
cover_prompt: A vibrant, full-color cartoon illustration of a cheerful underwater ocean scene for a children's coloring book cover. A cute smiling dolphin, a friendly sea turtle, and a happy clownfish swimming together among colorful coral reefs and seaweed. Bright blue water background with bubbles and starfish. Eye-catching, professional children's book cover art style. Bright saturated colors, cheerful joyful composition. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the image. Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12.
